cohort: 80 primigravida pregnant women, 40 with preeclampsia and 40 normotensive controls
finding: Pregnant women with preeclampsia had higher leptin levels and were more likely to give birth via cesarean section and have infants with low birth weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with preeclampsia.
birth_weight: lower in infants of mothers with preeclampsia
